provenance.transformation: Member iff the scenario-owned measured ciprofloxacin MIC is strictly greater than the exact configured founder genotype MIC.
provenance.limitation: This is a within-scenario elevated-MIC cohort for Petra analysis. It is not a clinical susceptibility/resistance breakpoint, treatment recommendation, or claim that every mutation is resistant.

provenance.rationale: Make every accepted composed snapshot eligible for authoritative aggregate metric extraction. Eligibility is expressed in biological tick identity and does not borrow renderer publication, animation frame rate, or chart decimation cadence.
provenance.limitation: LiveAnalysisHistory observes accepted snapshots only. A multi-tick advance can therefore produce a sparse history (for example ticks 0, 16, 32) even with everyTicks=1; this policy does not claim one emitted row per internal biological tick. Dense playback-independent capture would require a simulator/runtime sampling path, never App/React interpolation.
